item.summary: refactor(agents): consolidate session auth selection behind prepared-facts facade (#126084) * fix(subagents): drop dead announce gateway-context resolver plumbing #126062 left caller-supplied announce gateway-context resolvers behind after binding dispatch to the Gateway instance. Remove the dead plumbing that broke prod-types in gateway-scope lanes. * refactor(agents): consolidate session auth selection behind prepared-facts facade Completes #123894's redesign by deduplicating the four session-auth call-site preludes and deleting inference-runtime's duplicate route re-derivation.
